# Fixture-001: Simple Shirt Front-to-Back Benchmark

This directory is reserved for two immutable local benchmark assets:

- `front.png`: observed Front source
- `expected_back.png`: known Back evaluation reference

The assets are local evaluation references only. They are not approved for
model training or customer publication.

Before committing the image files, confirm SuiSakhi ownership or explicit
licensing and update `ownershipStatus` in both the Dart registry and
`fixture_manifest.json`.
